blocks.text: Era Zero now has 306 canonical roots and 18 provisional roots in 2 nine-root chunks. No completed review packet awaits a decision. The broad English translator remains blocked. The next semantic block is ORI:100–122. It was not begun in this packet. Gate 4, the compound architecture, and translator implementation remain deferred.
